elements.name: Darkvision
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

elements.name: Gliding Wings
elements.desc: While you're in your natural form and don't have the Incapacitated condition, when you fall, you subtract up to 100 feet from the distance fallen when calculating the fall's damage, and you can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot you descend.

elements.name: Natural Weaponry
elements.desc: While you're in your natural form, your wings and tail are powerful weapons. As a Bonus Action, you can use your wings or tail to make an Unarmed Strike to Shove a creature.

elements.name: Visage
elements.desc: As a Magic action, you can shape-shift into a humanoid form called your visage, or back to your natural form. Your visage has a specific appearance that you choose when you select this species, including your coloration, height and weight, hair length, and sex. Changing shape with this trait doesn't change your clothing, equipment, or game statistics.

elements.name: Draconic Flight
elements.desc: When you reach character level 5, you can use your natural form's wings to fly short distances. As a Bonus Action, you leap into the air and give yourself a Fly Speed equal to your Speed that lasts for 10 minutes. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Dracthyr
elements.desc: Dragon. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Darkvision, Gliding Wings, Natural Weaponry, Visage, Draconic Flight.

elements.name: Eredar Lineage
elements.desc:
You are part of a lineage related to your ancestors' embrace of the Light—or of the power of the Burning Legion. This lineage grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Eredar Lineages table: Draenei, Krokul, Lightforged, or Man'ari. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose when you select the lineage).

Eredar Lineages

Lineage | Level 1 | Level 3 | Level 5

Draenei | You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. You also know the Spare the Dying cantrip. | Healing Word | Prayer of Healing

Krokul | You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also know the Poison Spray cantrip. | Ray of Sickness | Hold Person

Lightforged | You have Resistance to Radiant damage. You also know the Sacred Flame cantrip. | Guiding Bolt | Aid

Man'ari | You have Resistance to Fire damage. You also know the Fire Bolt cantrip. | Hellish Rebuke | Darkness

elements.name: Heroic Presence
elements.desc: When you cast a spell granted by your Eredar Lineage, if you don't have Heroic Inspiration, you gain it. You can gain Heroic Inspiration in this way once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

elements.name: Draenei
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Eredar Lineage, Heroic Presence.

elements.name: Dwarf
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: .

elements.name: Azerite Surge
elements.desc:
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a blast of Azerite energy in a 15-foot Cone. Each creature of your choice in the Cone regains 1d10 Hit Points. Each other creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and your Proficiency Bonus), taking 1d10 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Both the damage and the healing increase by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Darkvision (Earthen)
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

elements.name: Earthen Resilience
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

elements.name: Ingest Minerals
elements.desc: You don't gain Exhaustion levels from malnutrition.

elements.name: Quiet Contemplation
elements.desc: When you spend Hit Point Dice when you finish a Short Rest, you regain 1 additional Hit Point per Hit Point Die you spend.

elements.name: Earthen
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Azerite Surge, Darkvision (Earthen), Earthen Resilience, Ingest Minerals, Quiet Contemplation.

elements.name: Elf
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: .

elements.name: Deathly Endurance
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

elements.name: Everlasting
elements.desc: You don't gain Exhaustion levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation. You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

elements.name: Touch of the Grave
elements.desc:
When you deal damage to a creature, you can roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You deal extra Necrotic damage to the creature equal to the total rolled, and you regain a number of Hit Points equal to the extra damage dealt.

Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Will of the Forsaken
elements.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

elements.name: Forsaken
elements.desc: Undead. Small or Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Deathly Endurance, Everlasting, Touch of the Grave, Will of the Forsaken.

elements.name: Gnome
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: .

elements.name: Fey Ancestry
elements.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

elements.name: Fury of the Small
elements.desc:
When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your Proficiency Bonus and is the same damage type as the other damage dealt.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest, and you can use it no more than once per turn.

elements.name: Nimble Escape
elements.desc: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

elements.name: Goblin
elements.desc: Humanoid. Small. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Fey Ancestry, Fury of the Small, Nimble Escape.

elements.name: Darkvision (Haranir)
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

elements.id: Racial Trait:Gift of the World Tree (WoW)
elements.name: Gift of the World Tree
elements.desc: Because of your supernatural connection to the world trees, you have proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills.

elements.name: Haranir Magic
elements.desc:
You know the Druidcraft and Thorn Whip cantrips.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the Entangle spell. You always have it prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

When you reach character level 5, you also always have the Spike Growth spell prepared and can cast it the same way.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).

elements.name: Haranir
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Darkvision (Haranir), Gift of the World Tree, Haranir Magic.

rules.grant: Racial Trait:Gift of the World Tree (WoW)

elements.name: Human
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: .

elements.name: Built for Success
elements.desc: You can add 1d4 to one D20 Test you make, and you can do so after rolling the die but before resolving the effects of the roll. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Emergency Fail-Safe
elements.desc: When you become Bloodied, you can take a Reaction to spend one Hit Point Die, roll it, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

elements.name: Mechanical Nature
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Poison damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Paralyzed or Poisoned condition. You don't gain Exhaustion levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation.

elements.name: Sentry's Rest
elements.desc: You don't need to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 6 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

elements.name: Specialized Design
elements.desc: You gain proficiency with two type=tool;artisan's tools;instrument;gaming set of your choice.

elements.name: Mechagnome
elements.desc: Construct. Small. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Built for Success, Emergency Fail-Safe, Mechanical Nature, Sentry's Rest, Specialized Design.

elements.name: Orc
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: .

elements.name: Bouncy
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning damage from falling.

elements.name: Inner Peace
elements.desc: When you spend Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points after a Short Rest, you regain 1 additional Hit Point per Hit Point Die you expend.

elements.name: Quaking Palm
elements.desc: When you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature until the end of your turn.

elements.name: Pandaren
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Bouncy, Inner Peace, Quaking Palm.

elements.name: Horns
elements.desc: Your horns are powerful natural weapons. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Piercing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.

elements.name: Goring Rush
elements.desc: Immediately after you take the Dash action on your turn and move at least 20 feet, you can make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

elements.name: Hammering Horns
elements.desc: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a Bonus Action to shove that target with an Unarmed Strike as long as the target is within 5 feet of you. When you shove a target in this way, you can push the target up to 10 feet away instead of 5 feet.

elements.name: Tauren Lineage
elements.desc:
You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural qualities. If your lineage grants you an ability that allows a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom modifier (choose when you select the lineage) and Proficiency Bonus. Choose one of the following options:

• Mulgore Tauren. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a magically empowered stomp on the ground. You can't use this feature if you have the Prone condition or if you are flying, climbing, or swimming. When you use your war stomp, each creature of your choice within a 5-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the Stunned condition until the end of your current turn.

• Highmountain Tauren. As an action, you can move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of other creatures. Each Medium or smaller creature whose space you enter makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Strength modifier and has the Prone condition. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

• Taunka. Your shaggy hide gives you a +1 bonus to Armor Class and Resistance to Cold damage.

elements.name: Tauren
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Horns, Goring Rush, Hammering Horns, Tauren Lineage.

elements.name: Bloodied Frenzy
elements.desc: While Bloodied, you have Advantage on attack rolls.

elements.name: Troll Healing
elements.desc: When you expend Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points after a Short Rest, you regain Hit Points equal to the maximum roll of the dice plus your Constitution modifier.

elements.name: Troll Lineage
elements.desc:
You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural qualities. Choose one of the following options:

• Amani Troll. Whenever you spend Heroic Inspiration, you regain 1 expended Hit Point Die.

• Darkspear Troll. When you take the Dash action, Difficult Terrain composed of ice, rubble, snow, or undergrowth doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of your turn.

• Zandalari Troll. If you roll a 1 on the d20 for a D20 Test, you gain Heroic Inspiration at the end of the current turn.

elements.name: Troll
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Bloodied Frenzy, Troll Healing, Troll Lineage.

elements.name: Fire Resistance
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Fire damage.

elements.name: Nose for Trouble
elements.desc: The first time you take damage after you roll Initiative, you reduce the damage you take by your level (to a minimum of 0 damage).

elements.name: Vulpera Nimbleness
elements.desc: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

elements.name: Vulpera
elements.desc: Humanoid. Small. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Fire Resistance, Nose for Trouble, Vulpera Nimbleness.

elements.name: Darkflight
elements.desc:
As a Bonus Action, you can shape-shift to assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you revert to your normal appearance as a Bonus Action. When you enter your bestial form, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 times your Proficiency Bonus. You can enter this form a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

In your bestial form, you gain the following benefits:

• Increased Speed. Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

• Reactive Movement. You can take a Reaction to move up to 10 feet when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This reactive movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

• Necrotic Resistance. You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

elements.name: Instinctual Shift
elements.desc: When you roll Initiative while you have one or more uses of your Darkflight species trait remaining, you can immediately use that trait to shape-shift (no action required).

elements.name: Worgen
elements.desc: Humanoid. Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Darkflight, Instinctual Shift.
